Chapter 803: Chapter 17: Astonishing Harvest (Eight Thousand Words, Two Chapters Combined)_3

…

Void Secret Realm.

Vast and expansive.

After three hundred years of exploration, Lin Yuan Taiyang Divine Spirit had ventured deep into the secret realm.

In these years, Lin Yuan occasionally acted, slaying Void Creatures, earning a great reputation among the Evil Gods, belonging to one of the strongest in the Ninth Stage Evil Gods.

Many Evil Gods conferred the title ‘Taiyang Divine Master’ upon Lin Yuan.

...

Whenever Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit made a move, immense flames would incinerate everything, which is a trait inherent to the Taiyang Divine Spirit. If it were the Taiyin Primordial Spirit acting, it would be an endless bitter cold freezing everything.

It’s not that the Taiyin Primordial Spirit lacks other means, but this method is the most convenient and powerful, and closest to his own Great Dao.

“It has been a long time since I encountered a Ninth Stage Void Creature.”

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit traversed the high skies of the Void Secret Realm, initially cautious upon entering, hiding among many Spatial Layers to avoid detection by powerful Void Creatures as much as possible.

But now.

Lin Yuan wished other Void Creatures would discover him.

“Master, Ninth Stage Void Creatures are incredibly rare, it’s normal not to encounter them,” immediately said the Lord of the Three Yin nearby.

The Lord of the Three Yin, ruled by Lin Yuan in the Tianqing World’s Void Domain.

After Lin Yuan suppressed the Black Demon Pavilion Master and four Evil Gods, the Lord of the Three Yin became aware of it.

The Lord of the Three Yin realized that Lin Yuan was not to be trifled with and ordered other Evil Gods to steer clear of the sector containing Tianqing World.

However,

two hundred and ninety years ago, the Lord of the Three Yin could no longer resist, wanting to get close to Tianqing World to see the mysterious powerful being who had silently made the Black Demon Pavilion Master and four Evil Gods disappear.

The idea of the Lord of the Three Yin was simple, merely to glance from afar, never to approach closely, and to immediately retreat at any sign of anomaly.

Being a peak Eighth Stage Evil God themselves, under such caution, even a regular Ninth Stage Evil God would have few options.

But what the Lord of the Three Yin encountered was Lin Yuan.

Just when Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit returned, wanting to collect some Demon Tree Seeds, he encountered the skulking Lord of the Three Yin and casually brought them back.

After a Soul Search and interrogation, Lin Yuan learned that the Lord of the Three Yin had access to the Void Secret Realm and was very familiar with it, so he subdued the Lord of the Three Yin.

Of course, Lin Yuan’s subduing of the Lord of the Three Yin was not superficial but the kind where a single thought could decide life or death.

“It is so.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Now for Lin Yuan, Void Creatures below the Ninth Stage barely enhance his Spirit Will.

Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will is too strong, even if not reaching ten million points, it’s not much less, hence, upgrading is naturally not easy.

“Hmm?”

While Lin Yuan and the Lord of the Three Yin wandered aimlessly in the depths of the Void Secret Realm.

A terrifying aura suddenly burst from an extremely distant place.

Boom – Horrendous fluctuations disrupted the spatial-temporal order, sweeping toward all directions.

“This fluctuation?”

“Are several Ninth Stage Evil Gods battling? Or is it a fight with like-ranked Void Creatures?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, feeling that there was more than one Ninth Stage Void Creature’s aura fluctuation.

“So powerful!”

The Lord of the Three Yin trembled inwardly.

Were it not for following Lin Yuan, with its strength, it could not have reached the depths of the Void Secret Realm. Here, in a long enough duration, they were bound to encounter Ninth Stage Evil Gods.

Or Ninth Stage Void Creatures.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan’s mind flickered, disappearing on the spot, heading towards the source of the aura fluctuation.

“Where is the Master?”

The Lord of the Three Yin, after finding Lin Yuan gone, also gritted its teeth and chased toward the source of the aura fluctuation.

…

This is a lair nearly a billion miles in size, originally hidden deep in layers of space and time, now exposed as the external Spatial-Temporal Maze was torn open, revealing the whole nest.

Threads of horrifying aura emanated, outside the lair, stood six massive figures.

Inside the lair, there were similarly terrifying auras lurking, with nearly ten breaths confronting the six massive figures outside.

During the standoff, they subtly clashed across spatial boundaries, causing spatial fluctuations that spread to distant places.

“Humph, the Void Creatures within this nest have all reached the Ninth Stage, and there are exactly nine of them, not easy to handle,” one of the six massive figures outside resembling an eight-tentacled octopus-like terrible Evil God sent a mental wave.

“How much will our Spirit Will increase if we kill these nine Ninth Stage Void Creatures?” a grey serpent-like Evil God roared, “Eight-Handed Lord, are you thinking of giving up?”

Among Ninth Stage Evil Gods, they are addressed as ‘Divine Master’.

As such, this eight-tentacled octopus Evil God was called the Eight-Handed Lord, and the grey serpent Evil God was known as the Heavenly Python Divine Master.

“Give up?”

“I certainly will not!”
